description: This Java source file defines the OfficeTransaction entity class, which models a financial transaction between offices within the Fineract application. It maps to the 'm_office_transaction' database table and includes fields for origin and destination offices, transaction date, amount, currency, and description. It also provides a static method to instantiate an object from JSON input.

classes.name: OfficeTransaction
classes.description: Entity class representing a financial transaction between offices, including transaction date, amount, involved offices, and description.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an OfficeTransaction instance from Office objects, a Money amount, and a JsonCommand containing input data.
